name: astrorize
description: AstroRize: public website + astrologer portal + admin console (frontend/) and the Node API (backend/).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,media -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev --prefix frontend" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run worker --prefix backend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web,media -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend" "npm run worker --prefix backend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
